title: Cross-functional comms ramp and release-note curation for adaptive-routing GA
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Goal: Coordinate a cross-functional communications sprint to publish coherent release notes, a customer-facing blog post, product emails, social highlights, and a launch webinar for the adaptive-routing GA. We need a single source of truth for feature descriptions, breaking changes, migration guidance, and performance expectations targeted at engineers and platform leads.

Scope:
- Curate and freeze release notes (technical and non-technical sections).
- Align blog draft with engineering performance benchmarks and example API snippets.
- Draft and schedule product emails for self-serve users and enterprise segments with upgrade guidance and known limitations.
- Produce 3 social tiles and short copy for LinkedIn and X.
- Plan webinar content, runbook, panelists, and Q&A triage.

Success criteria:
- Release notes finalized and reviewed by engineering and security by 2026-03-18.
- Blog ready for publish with final assets and performance callouts by 2026-03-22.
- Email cohorts drafted and QAed with localization placeholders by 2026-03-24.
- Webinar registration page live and recording plan confirmed two days before GA.

Risks and constraints:
- Last-minute infra regressions could require note updates; we need an approvals fast-lane.
- Security review may add copy gating; early kickoff with SRE/security owners required.

Artifacts: Confluence spec (https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PR/adaptive-routing-ga), blog draft (Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ARoutingGA), release notes template (Drive: https://drive.google.com/release-notes/template), webinar signup (https://events.redwood.ai/adaptive-routing-ga).
